Zelenije = bujnije biljke. Narandžasto/c: Greener = lusher plants. Orange/red = weaker or smaller. Focus on those weaker areas, not the green ones.
Zelenije = bujnije i jače sadnice. Žuto: Greener = lusher, stronger seedlings. Yellow / orange / red = less vigorous, smaller, or weaker than the parcel average on the image date. This is not a disease "from satellite" — a sign: "check here first".
Zelenije = bujnije. Ako isti deo dugo os: Greener = lusher. If the same area stays orange/red for a long time, it is probably not a single-image error: seedlings there are persistently less vigorous than the rest of the orchard.
Zelenije znači jača vegetacija. Nagli pa: Greener means stronger vegetation. A sharp drop toward orange/red means that area is weaker vs. the previous image — plants there look less vigorous. Sometimes the image "lies" because of clouds, so verify on the ground.
